$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema URL for editor autocomplete.

workspaceRoot.description: Folder to scan for Git repositories. ~ is expanded.

mirrorRoot.description: Directory for bare mirror repos. ~ is expanded.

remoteName.description: Git remote name to manage. Never modifies other remotes.

excludeDirNames.description: Directory names skipped while walking the workspace (e.g. node_modules).

excludeRepoGlobs.description: Glob patterns matched against repo paths relative to workspaceRoot.

style.description: Preserve relative path under mirrorRoot (foo/bar → foo/bar.git).

safeDirectory.description: per-mirror adds each mirror path to global git safe.directory (~/.gitconfig). Use off to disable.

allowForceWithLease.description: If true, permits CLI --force-with-lease (still requires --repo or --all-repos). Never enables force by itself.

captureWorktree.description: If true, snapshot dirty worktrees (including untracked files that are not gitignored) to refs/ingotvault/wip/<host>/… and push them. Opt-in; respects .gitignore. Does not change the commits-only default promise.

wipRetention.description: Keep the newest N WIP refs per worktree slug (per host); older local refs are deleted and pruned on the mirror for that host only. This rolling window is the only thing ingotvault deletes from a mirror.

wipExclude.description: Extra git pathspecs excluded from WIP snapshots beyond .gitignore (e.g. ".env.local", "tmp/**").

logDir.description: Directory for --scheduled log files. ~ is expanded.

logRetentionDays.description: Delete --scheduled logs older than this many days when writing a new log. 0 keeps forever.
